categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Kelin Electric Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the electric machinery and equipment manufacturing industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of power grid digital intelligent sensing products, energy storage systems, and perovskite photovoltaic modules. The company also provides related power technology services and has extended its business into robot six-dimensional force sensors and other high-value components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including intelligent sensing, digital twin platforms, AI-driven fault diagnosis algorithms, laser photoacoustic acetylene rapid detection, and perovskite photovoltaic manufacturing techniques such as magnetron sputtering, vacuum evaporation, slit coating, and atomic layer deposition. It employs modular design and system integration for energy storage, with a focus on multi-physical field sensing (sound, light, electricity, magnetism, heat, force) and edge-cloud collaborative computing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major power grid companies such as State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, as well as engineering contractors and industrial clients in the energy sector. The company serves markets across the entire power system chain including generation, transmission, transformation, and distribution, with growing penetration in new energy storage and photovoltaic sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant market presence in East China (notably Zhejiang province), North China, Central China, South China, Southwest China, Northwest China, and Northeast China. It has expanded its energy storage projects beyond Zhejiang to other provinces, enhancing its regional market influence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hangzhou Kelin Electric operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the power industry supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and integrating intelligent sensing devices, energy storage systems, and photovoltaic modules, as well as providing technical services and solutions for power grid operation and maintenance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in smart grid sensing technologies, energy storage integration, and perovskite photovoltaic industrialization. It emphasizes R&D in AI-based fault diagnosis, digital twin platforms, flexible perovskite solar cells, and robot six-dimensional force sensors. Strategic R&D projects include digital platforms for transmission and distribution, high-efficiency flexible perovskite thin-film solar cells, and virtual power plant systems, aiming to lead in new energy and embodied intelligence markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of intelligent sensing equipment, energy storage systems, and photovoltaic modules, complemented by income from power-related technical services and power station operations. Sales are conducted via bidding, inquiry, and competitive negotiation, with a significant portion from large-scale energy storage projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is recognized as a national key high-tech enterprise and a leader in the new power system intelligent sensing field, holding international leading technologies and multiple industry standards. It competes in the smart grid, energy storage, and photovoltaic sectors, maintaining a strong position through technological innovation and comprehensive product offerings, with few domestic peers matching its integrated capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 541 million, a 168% increase year-over-year, driven mainly by growth in energy storage business. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 73 million, up 55%, with total assets exceeding RMB 1.14 billion, reflecting rapid expansion and strong financial growth. R&D investment accounted for about 8% of revenue, supporting sustained innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hangzhou Kelin Electric offers unique value through its advanced multi-physical field intelligent sensing technologies, rapid online fault detection capabilities, and integrated energy storage solutions that enhance grid reliability and efficiency. Its perovskite photovoltaic products feature high efficiency and flexible applications, while its robot six-dimensional force sensors provide high precision for emerging robotics markets. The company emphasizes customization, real-time monitoring, and AI-driven predictive maintenance to differentiate from traditional power equipment providers.
